exposure: Intrathecal epinephrine (0 mcg, 100 mcg, or 200 mcg) in addition to spinal bupivacaine, morphine, and fentanyl
cohort: 1,362 patients undergoing repeat cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia from 2011 to 2015
finding: The addition of intrathecal epinephrine for women undergoing cesarean delivery increased intraoperative vasopressor use but did not prolong PACU length of stay, reduce intraoperative opioids, or increase antiemetic requirements postoperatively.
